_provenance: SYNTHETIC. Not a live recording. Every id, path, prompt, file name and tool result in this directory was invented for the test suite; no Cursor conversation was copied into the repo. The RECORD SHAPES — table and key names, field names, value types, the 1=user/2=assistant bubble type, the header-array ordering, which fields are present on which generation of record — are modelled on Cursor 3.15.19 on macOS, whose ~/Library/Application Support/Cursor/User/{globalStorage,workspaceStorage}/state.vscdb databases were inspected read-only on 2026-09-06. Cursor documents none of this, so a later Cursor may write something else; re-inspect before trusting these shapes as current.

files.global-state.json: stands in for globalStorage/state.vscdb: cursorDiskKV rows keyed composerData:<id> and bubbleId:<composerId>:<bubbleId>, plus the newer composerHeaders table.
files.workspaces.json: stands in for workspaceStorage/<hash>/: workspace.json's folder URI and ItemTable['composer.composerData'].
files.empty-state.json: a database with the tables but no conversations in them.
